title: hone/standard: module
description: Additional schema of the kind `module` (lifecycle `living`). A module is a named boundary in Ousterhout's sense: an interface behind which secrets are hidden. It is not bound to any form (function, class, file, package, subsystem, service). The anchors say where it lives in the code.

parent.description: ID of the enclosing module. Modules form a tree or forest.

interface.description: The interface of the module: a reference into code, a short description, or both.
